review_note: Non-consumable, not a subscription. Unlocks a permanent x1.25 delivery payout multiplier and lets the player claim the sponsor cash bonus without watching a rewarded video. Reach it: Business tab (bottom bar, right) -> Shop & sponsor bonus -> Empire Pass -> Buy. Restore Purchases is in the same Shop panel. Offline single-player game; no account; any sandbox Apple ID works.
